text: Hey folks, quick q: I upgraded my home internet last month and the bill is $95, which is $20 over the monthly stipend. Can I get reimbursed for the full amount or just the $75? Not sure what the process is if it goes over.

Hey Benji, good question. So, if your internet bill goes over the $75 stipend, you can usually get up to $100 reimbursed if you get your manager to approve it first. Just attach the bill and a quick note from your manager to the regular expense form. This isn't written down anywhere yet, but that's what we've been doing.
Awesome, thanks Derek! I'll ping my manager and submit the form with the bill. Appreciate the quick answer.
